03 — ABOUTWHO I AM

I like figuring out how things work by building them.

My name is Sreeni, and I'm a student at South Brunswick High School. Most of my projects start with something I wanted for myself, like a keyboard I'd actually enjoy typing on, a quiet air purifier, or a business card that does something. I'm always in the middle of building something, and a lot of it ends up flying. I do the CAD, the electronics, and the code myself, and I learn a lot from testing what I've built.
